response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS record_count, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(ab.abhvreg)) OVER () AS share_percent FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: Traders with NULL tradekind are included in results as a separate group; the documented enum values do not necessarily require excluding NULL from the output.
